title: Collect latest public Brent and WTI crude-oil futures prices
purpose: Research-only snapshot of public market data, with source URLs and timestamps.
requiredFields: latest price in USD per barrel
secondary source URL and cross-check status

sourcePolicy.ifUnavailable: Mark source unavailable and report partial/blocked status

permissions.network: Public HTTPS GET requests only to the two hard-coded source hosts

completionCriteria: Brent and WTI each include latest and previous daily closes when available
Daily dollar and percentage changes are calculated from the same source's two latest valid closes
UTC timestamp and source URLs are included
Secondary-source check is marked verified, mismatch, or unavailable
Source or contract timing differences are disclosed
No financial recommendation or trade instruction is generated
